sloka: निहतैः कुञ्जरैर्मत्तैस्तथा वानरराक्षसैः ।चक्राक्षयुगदण्डैश्च भग्नैर्धरणिसंश्रितैः ।बभूवायोधनं घोरं गोमायुगणसङ्कुलम् ।। ६.४३.४३ ।।।।
transliteration: nihataiḥ kuñjarairmattaistathā vānararākṣasaiḥ ।cakrākṣayugadaṇḍaiśca bhagnairdharaṇisaṁśritaiḥ ।babhūvāyodhanaṁ ghoraṁ gomāyugaṇasaṅkulam ।। 6.43.43 ।।।।

translations.english: The battlefield was dreadful and, frequented by jackals with spears, javelins, maces, and swords, strewn all over, similarly with broken chariots, horses, elephants, and monkeys fit for war. Broken wheels and axles of chariots were found all over.
